featured_reviews.name: Prem Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
About Teachers

All the teachers are well-educated and highly qualified. They teach in a simple and easy-to-understand manner, making learning more accessible. Mathematics, which is usually a difficult subject, has become easier for me because of my math teacher. She always clears our doubts patiently. All the teachers are kind, supportive, and always willing to share their knowledge with us.

About the Classroom

The classrooms are spacious and well-maintained. Cleanliness is always ensured, and the benches are in good condition. Even without an exam pad, we can write our papers comfortably on the benches. Each classroom is equipped with 12 lights and 15 fans, all in proper working condition.

About the IT Lab

The IT Lab is large and fully air-conditioned, accommodating up to 60 students at a time. All computers are in good working condition, and students perform practicals themselves for better hands-on learning.

About the Library

The library has a vast collection of books on various subjects. Students can borrow books using their library cards, making learning more accessible and convenient.

About Cultural Activities

DAAS and ASHOKA are the two most anticipated events of this college. Students eagerly wait for these events from the beginning of the academic year. Various cultural and sports activities are organized, allowing students from different colleges to participate. Winners receive trophies and certificates. The event lasts for 3 to 4 days and is one of the biggest in the locality.

About the College

The college provides opportunities for every student willing to study. It has a large campus with excellent facilities, including a turf field for sports.

Student Review

I have developed many skills during my time at this college. My speaking skills have improved, and the opportunity to be a Class Representative (CR) has helped me enhance my leadership and management abilities. I believe these skills will benefit my future career. I have also experienced significant academic growth.

featured_reviews.name: varun surve
featured_reviews.review_text:
My Journey at M.L. Dahanukar College of Commerce

As a proud alumnus of Parle Tilak Vidyalaya Association's M.L. Dahanukar College of Commerce, I can confidently say that this institution has played a significant role in shaping who I am today—both professionally and personally. Nestled in the heart of Vile Parle (East), Mumbai, Dahanukar College stands as a symbol of academic excellence, discipline, and vibrant student life.

A Legacy of Excellence

Established in 1960, M.L. Dahanukar College has a rich legacy of over six decades in the field of commerce education. Named after the well-known industrialist and philanthropist Late Shri Madhavji Laxmidas Dahanukar, the college is managed by the reputed Parle Tilak Vidyalaya Association (PTVA). The institution has grown consistently, adapting to the changing educational landscape while staying grounded in its values.

Academics and Faculty

The college offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs, including B.Com, BMS, BAF, BBI, BFM, and M.Com. The faculty members are not only well-qualified but also deeply committed to student success. Their teaching style is a perfect blend of theory and real-world applications, making lectures both informative and engaging.

Vibrant Campus Life

One of my fondest memories is participating in college festivals like "Kurukshetra", which brought out the best in us—teamwork, creativity, leadership, and a sense of community. From cultural events to seminars and NSS/NCC activities, the college provides an ideal environment for all-round development.

Infrastructure and Support

The college has excellent infrastructure with well-equipped classrooms, a computer lab, a library with a vast collection of books and journals, and a student-friendly environment. The administrative staff is also very cooperative and supportive, making student life smooth and hassle-free.

Alumni Pride

As an alumnus, I always carry the values and lessons I learned here with great pride. M.L. Dahanukar is not just a college—it’s a place where careers are nurtured, confidence is built, and dreams are turned into reality. It has produced many successful professionals across fields like finance, management, education, entrepreneurship, and civil services.

Conclusion:
Looking back, I feel grateful to be a part of this institution. The knowledge, skills, and values I received here continue to guide me in my journey. If you’re looking for a college that offers academic strength, a supportive environment, and vibrant student life, M.L. Dahanukar College of Commerce is the place to be.
